identity.name: Lakes of Delray
identity.notes: Lakes of Delray is a gated 55+ condominium community in Delray Beach, Florida (Palm Beach County), located off Atlantic Avenue between Military Trail and Jog Road, minutes from downtown Delray and the beach. It comprises approximately 1,400 resale condos built 1982–1994 by Lennar Homes in six building styles, with price range in the low-to-mid $200ks. The community features a large clubhouse, multiple pools, extensive sports courts, an activity director, weekly events, nearly 30 clubs, and community bus transit.

fees.note: HOA dues range from $198 to $662 per month depending on unit/association (per 55places.com listing). Exact amount should be verified with the HOA/management company; hoa-resource.com notes special assessments may apply for condo/roof/pool repairs (no specific assessment amounts stated).
HOA fee includes: common area maintenance, water, gas, snow removal (as listed by hoa-resource.com; snow removal likely a template error for a Florida community — verify with HOA).
